rules.en: Account for actual trainable tensors and optimizer state precision. BF16 release weights do not establish training precision. Muon/NVFP4 recipes need separate adapters.
rules.zh: 按可训练张量和优化器状态精度记账。BF16 发布权重不能证明训练精度；Muon／NVFP4 配方需要独立适配。

rules.en: Evaluate capacity, HBM traffic and interconnect traffic separately. Calibrate compute and collectives on the target topology; a capacity fit is not a speed claim.
rules.zh: 分别评估显存容量、HBM 流量与互联通信；用目标拓扑实测算力和集合通信。显存能放下，不代表运行最快。

rules.en: Re-plan every length stage; preserve short-task evaluation and inspect data-length distributions. Published lengths are release-specific, not universal token-share defaults.
rules.zh: 每个长度阶段重新规划，保留短任务评测并检查数据长度分布。官方长度只适用于对应版本，不是通用数据占比。

rules.en: Run a small scaling ladder and save/resume test before a large allocation. Fit measurements rather than copying vendor TFLOPS or a universal tokens-per-parameter ratio.
rules.zh: 大规模租卡前先做小规模 scaling ladder 和断点恢复测试；拟合实测值，不复制厂商 TFLOPS 或固定 token／参数比例。

rules.en: Log per-expert token counts, max/mean load, dropped tokens and all-to-all time at every length stage. A lower balance loss alone does not establish balanced work.
rules.zh: 各长度阶段记录逐专家 token、最大／平均负载、丢弃率和 all-to-all 耗时；均衡损失降低不代表真实负载均衡。

rules.en: Budget actor, reference, critic/reward and rollout pools by simultaneous residency. Include response lengths, group size, KV cache and asynchronous policy lag. MiMo-V2.6's router freezing is a scoped recipe, not a universal default.
rules.zh: 按同时驻留情况规划 actor、reference、critic／reward 和 rollout 池；包含回答长度、组大小、KV 与异步策略滞后。MiMo-V2.6 的路由冻结仅是特定配方，不是通用默认值。

rules.en: Track frozen/trainable components and image/audio/video token expansion by stage. A text-only activation estimate cannot certify multimodal training.
rules.zh: 逐阶段记录冻结／可训练模块和图像、音频、视频 token 展开；文本激活估算不能认证多模态训练。

release_references.note_en: Public RL: 1,568 prompts × 16 rollouts, staleness 4, frozen router. Do not replay the original training budget or substitute Adam-only memory accounting for Muown.
release_references.note_zh: 公开 RL：1,568 prompts × 16 rollouts，滞后 4、冻结路由器。不能照搬原始训练预算，也不能用纯 Adam 账本代替 Muown。

release_references.note_en: Sparse attention is introduced at 64K, with indexer warmup. The current Adam planner does not reproduce this recipe.
release_references.note_zh: 64K 阶段引入稀疏注意力并预热索引器。当前 Adam 规划器并不复现该官方配方。

release_references.note_en: Only GLM-5; not evidence for GLM-5.3-Flash or intermediate length shares.
release_references.note_zh: 仅适用于 GLM-5；不能移植为 GLM-5.3-Flash 的训练历史或推断中间长度占比。

release_references.note_en: Series-level report; checkpoint-specific phase allocation is not established. Not applicable to H3/M3.
release_references.note_zh: 系列报告；未确认各具体检查点的阶段配额。不适用于 H3／M3。

release_references.note_en: GB200: CP32 / TP8 / EP128 / PP2, 25,165,824 tokens/update, 33B LC tokens. Not independent world-size multipliers; not a supported Workbench launch.
release_references.note_zh: GB200：CP32／TP8／EP128／PP2，每步 25,165,824 token，长阶段共 33B token。并行轴不能全部独立相乘；不是本平台已支持的启动配方。

release_references.note_en: S1 freezes the LLM, first trains adapters then encoders; S2 unfreezes all. Do not apply to mainline Qwen3.8.
release_references.note_zh: S1 冻结 LLM，先适配器再编码器；S2 全部解冻。不能套给 Qwen3.8 主线。
